caption: Ladby Ship, Ladby
composition: A grass burial mound above a dark fjord · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Ladby ship site at night is a low grass mound with a plain doorway, a gravel path, and the dark fjord below. The path is empty and the museum is closed. The night is overcast, about 11.5°C. The cloud deck hides the moon, and a few lamps carry the light. No reconstructed ship is shown on the water.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Ladby ship mound at night, grass above a dark fjord
